payload_json.summary: Two separate maxroll builds found. (A) Harvest Flay Lich: Harvest is main damage skill with Flay for clear; transforms into Reaper Form for sweeping Cold melee; converts to Cold damage. (B) Death Seal Lich: Death Seal enables Low Life playstyle via Deadlock node; Waves of Death pulse necrotic damage; Rip Blood/Reap/Bone Curse are skills. The folk name 'Harvest Death Seal Lich' (combining both) is NOT a named build on maxroll — these are two separate builds.

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: Two-build folk name: Harvest Flay Lich (cold melee, Reaper Form) and Death Seal Lich (necrotic, Low Life, pulsing aura) are confirmed by maxroll as SEPARATE builds. The combined folk name 'Harvest Death Seal Lich' is not attested as a single guide. Mapped as a two-variant kit with both represented. Element_primary = water (cold — 'sweeping Cold melee attacks' is a genuine damage-type descriptor in dossier skill_loop). Death Seal variant: 'pulsing Waves of Death' — necrotic register maps to shadow per §1. Reaper Form: economy-agnostic form law; form is delivery context, not separate element identity. Verify_ledger shows UNSUPPORTED on era/identity/mechanics for le-harvest-lich — dossier populated in basin-2; mapping proceeds on dossier content as directed.

facts_json.evidence: Harvest scythe attacks at melee range; Death Seal modifies self not delivery pattern; primary delivery = at-target melee

facts_json.plain_text: Death Seal seals current HP as the maximum HP ceiling, preventing all healing above that threshold. The 'missing life' gap between sealed maximum and true maximum provides damage bonus. Self-cost sacrifice for power.

facts_json.evidence: Melee scythe sweeps cover small-radius close range

probe_facts.facts_json: Death Seal locks the Lich's HP at a fraction of maximum, converting missing HP into bonus Necrotic damage. Harvest scythe attacks at melee range shred targets. Damage scales inversely with remaining HP.

spine.mech_note: [VDM-1 basin-2 2026-07-18 ingest-11] CHIMERA (HIGH — Unattested Register; EXCLUDED from promotion): folk name 'Harvest Death Seal Lich' CONFLATES TWO real maxroll builds — Harvest Flay Lich (cold/HP-leech) and Death Seal Lich (necrotic/low-life) — different core skills, damage types, economies. All identity/mechanics/era claims for the COMBINED form are UNSUPPORTED (the all-U wall is the instrument WORKING). Steward ruling: do NOT split the kit record mid-run (schema surgery deferred to review book). Identity is UNATTESTED/chimera. [original mech_note follows] prov=kb. mech_note ref: 'Death Seal LOCKS your health at a fraction and pays you damage for the missing life while Harvest scythes through melee range.' NE suffix = Necrotic. Shield-split D1: defense is self-cost (glass cannon via intentional HP reduction), NOT ward/shield. Different from le-reaper-form-lich's leech defense. Death Seal = economy=self-cost; Harvest = the delivery tool.
